The '''Thobek system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Farlax sector/Legends|Farlax sector]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thobek]].
